meta.title: Bloom — Grow beautifully.
meta.description: Bloom is a personal growth garden. Every meaningful effort plants a seed. Every focused hour helps your garden bloom.

home.gardenWaiting: Your garden has been waiting for you. Let's grow beautifully together.

great: Today you planted new blooms. Every small step you completed is quietly shaping the future you dream of. 🌸
Your garden grew because you kept your promises to yourself. Consistency is becoming your greatest strength. 🌷
You spent most of today creating rather than consuming. That quiet discipline is what makes beautiful lives bloom. 🌿
okay: You showed up today, and that's what matters most. Your garden is patient, and so are you. 🌿
A gentle day is still a good day. Rest is part of growing too. 🌱
low: It's quiet today, and that's alright. Your garden will still be here, waiting patiently for you. ☁️
Some days are for resting roots, not growing petals. Come back whenever you're ready. 🌥️

reflection.subtitle: You've shown up today. Write a small message to your future self.
reflection.perfectSubtitle: Every task, complete. Your garden glows a little brighter today.

momentum.title: Momentum Rules
momentum.subtitle: Gentle nudges, never punishments.
momentum.quietMessage: It's been quiet for a little while. That's alright — your garden simply rests, waiting for you.
momentum.rule1: A day of rest gently softens your garden — nothing more.
momentum.rule2: A few quiet days in a row, and petals fall slowly. They always grow back.
